principles: Test a decision, not a vague desire to improve copy.
Change as few material components as feasible when mechanism interpretation matters.
If testing a bundle, label the estimand as bundle effect.
Choose a primary outcome before looking at results.
Record exposure assignment and implementation failures.
Use guardrail outcomes for trust, complaints, unsubscribes, refunds or downstream quality where relevant.
Do not stop only when significance/winner appears unless the design explicitly supports sequential testing.
Preserve null, adverse and heterogeneous results.
Predefine which runtime object may update if the result passes the decision rule.

mechanism_identification_levels.name: Outcome-only
mechanism_identification_levels.meaning: Experiment estimates copy/variant effect but does not identify mechanism.

mechanism_identification_levels.name: Mechanism-consistent
mechanism_identification_levels.meaning: Intervention is designed around a mechanism and outcomes are consistent, but alternative mechanisms remain.

mechanism_identification_levels.name: Mechanism-supported
mechanism_identification_levels.meaning: Includes manipulation/measurement that discriminates the target mechanism with adequate validity.

mechanism_identification_levels.name: Scientific-candidate
mechanism_identification_levels.meaning: Design/evidence may justify entering scientific claim lifecycle, still not automatic promotion.
